references.text: The same instruction regarding the seven priests carrying seven ram's horns before the ark, which is carried out here in verse 13.
Parallel description of the procession with the priests, the ark, the vanguard and the rearguard blowing the horns.
The priests shall blow the trumpets, an arrangement given by God through Moses.
The Lord's ark went before the Israelites, a similar procession with the ark.
The jubilee horn (shofar) is mentioned in connection with the Jubilee year, the same type of horn used here.
The Israelites were to follow behind the ark of the covenant, which is central in the procession around Jericho.
